button.label: Insert Interlinear
button.supertip: Copy an interlinear selection in FLEx and click here, or paste the text into the document, select it, and click here. The example is drawn as a borderless table, one column per alignment slot, wrapped to the page.

button.label: Convert Table
button.screentip: Convert a plain table into an interlinear example
button.supertip: Turns an ordinary Word table -- typed by hand or pasted from a spreadsheet -- into an auto-wrapping interlinear example. One row per tier.

button.label: Re-wrap This
button.screentip: Re-wrap the example at the cursor
button.supertip: Recomputes the wrap from scratch, so columns move down when space runs out and back up when it is freed -- after a margin, font or orientation change, or an edit.

button.label: Re-wrap All
button.screentip: Re-wrap every example in the document
button.supertip: Also runs automatically when the document is saved. Turn that off with the LingTeX_RewrapOnSave document variable.

button.label: Split Column
button.screentip: Split the column at the cursor
button.supertip: Pulls an affix, clitic or reduplicant out into an alignment column of its own, carrying the morpheme break character onto the start of the new column on every interlinear tier. Use it to morpheme-align part of an otherwise word-aligned example.

button.label: Merge Columns
button.supertip: Select across several cells to merge exactly those. With the cursor in a single cell, that column is merged with the one after it.

button.label: Check Glossing
button.screentip: Check the example against the glossing conventions
button.supertip: Reports columns whose cells disagree about a morpheme break character, spaces inside interlinear cells, form and gloss showing a different number of morpheme breaks, and unmatched infix brackets. Offers to fix the ones that have a single right answer. Grammatical glosses are recognised by their shape, so your own abbreviations are never flagged as unknown.
